symbols.name_fr: Fréquence d'onde additionnelle de mesure
symbols.description: Additional measuring frequency, transmitted or measured on request.

symbols.name_fr: Fréquence d'une onde de signalisation
symbols.description: Signalling frequency.

symbols.name_fr: Bande de fréquences
symbols.description: Frequency band. Note 1 - If it is desired to show whether a particular band of frequencies is erect or inverted, symbol 10-21-13 or 10-21-16 should be used. Note 2 - The order of a band of frequencies forming part of a transmission system may be indicated by adding oblique strokes according to the note to symbol 10-21-04.
notes: If it is desired to show whether a particular band of frequencies is erect or inverted, symbol 10-21-13 or 10-21-16 should be used.
The order of a band of frequencies forming part of a transmission system may be indicated by adding oblique strokes according to the note to symbol 10-21-04.

symbols.name_fr: Groupe tertiaire
symbols.description: Example: Mastergroup. The division of a band into channels, groups, etc., may be shown by adding vertical lines.

symbols.name_en: Band of frequencies divided into five channels (example)
symbols.name_fr: Bande de fréquences comprise entre f1 et f2, divisée en cinq voies, groupes, etc.
symbols.description: Example: Band of frequencies f1 to f2 divided into five channels, groups, etc.

symbols.name_fr: Bande directe de fréquences
symbols.description: Erect band of frequencies. Note 1 - There is no indication of how much of the bandwidth shown by the symbol is actually used. Note 2 - This symbol may be used to represent a single channel, group, etc., or a number of channels, groups, etc., providing they are all erect.
notes: There is no indication of how much of the bandwidth shown by the symbol is actually used.
This symbol may be used to represent a single channel, group, etc., or a number of channels, groups, etc., providing they are all erect.

symbols.name_en: Band of frequencies consisting of a group of 12 erect channels (example)
symbols.name_fr: Bandes directes de fréquences pour un groupe de 12 voies
symbols.description: Example: Band of frequencies consisting of a group of 12 erect channels.

symbols.name_fr: Forme simplifiée
symbols.description: Example, simplified form: Band of frequencies consisting of a group of 12 erect channels (simplified form).

symbols.name_fr: Bande inverse de fréquences
symbols.description: Inverted band of frequencies. The notes to symbol 10-21-13 apply.

symbols.name_en: Band of mixed channels, some erect, remainder inverted
symbols.name_fr: Bande de voies, groupes, etc., les uns directs et les autres inverses
symbols.description: Band of mixed channels, groups, etc., some erect, remainder inverted.

symbols.name_fr: Fréquence d'une onde porteuse à modulation d'amplitude avec les deux bandes latérales
symbols.description: Amplitude-modulated carrier with both sidebands.

symbols.name_en: Phase modulated carrier with both sidebands
symbols.name_fr: Fréquence d'une onde porteuse à modulation de phase avec les deux bandes latérales
symbols.description: Phase modulated carrier with both sidebands. Note - For frequency modulation, replace φ by f.
notes: For frequency modulation, replace φ by f.

symbols.name_en: Amplitude-modulated carrier with both sidebands, lower modulating frequencies not transmitted
symbols.name_fr: Fréquence d'une onde porteuse à modulation d'amplitude avec les deux bandes latérales; les basses fréquences du signal modulant n'étant pas transmises
symbols.description: Amplitude-modulated carrier with both sidebands, lower modulating frequencies not being transmitted.

symbols.name_en: Amplitude-modulated carrier with both sidebands, modulating frequencies down to zero transmitted
symbols.name_fr: Fréquence d'une onde porteuse à modulation d'amplitude avec les deux bandes latérales; les basses fréquences (jusqu'à zéro) du signal modulant étant transmises
symbols.description: Amplitude-modulated carrier with both sidebands, modulating frequencies down to zero being transmitted.

symbols.name_fr: Bande latérale unique et onde porteuse supprimée (cas de la transmission de la bande inférieure inverse)
symbols.description: Single-sideband suppressed carrier (case of transmission of the inverted lower band).

symbols.name_en: Reduced-carrier with single, lower, erect sideband
symbols.name_fr: Bande latérale unique et onde porteuse réduite (cas de la transmission de la bande inférieure directe)
symbols.description: Reduced-carrier with single, lower, erect sideband (case of transmission of the erect lower band).

symbols.name_en: Suppressed-carrier with single-sideband scrambled for secrecy
symbols.name_fr: Onde porteuse supprimée avec bande latérale unique divisée en trois parties, transposées pour assurer le secret
symbols.description: Suppressed-carrier with single-sideband scrambled for secrecy.

symbols.name_en: Amplitude-modulated carrier with upper sideband and lower vestigial sideband
symbols.name_fr: Onde porteuse en modulation d'amplitude, avec une bande latérale supérieure et une bande résiduelle inférieure; les basses fréquences (jusqu'à zéro) du signal modulant étant transmises
symbols.description: Amplitude-modulated carrier with upper sideband and lower vestigial sideband, modulating frequencies down to zero being transmitted.

symbols.name_en: Band of five channels, four inverted and one erect
symbols.name_fr: Bande de cinq voies, groupes, etc., dont un est direct et quatre inverses
symbols.description: Band of five channels, groups, etc., four of which are inverted and one erect.

symbols.name_en: 4 MHz transmission system showing supergroups and pilot frequencies
symbols.name_fr: Système de transmission de 4 MHz avec indication des groupes secondaires et des fréquences pilotes (voir ci-dessous)
symbols.description: 4 MHz transmission system showing supergroups and pilot frequencies (see below).

symbols.name_fr: Fibre optique

symbols.description: Guided light transmitter (light transmitter for optical fibre system).

symbols.description: Guided light receiver (light receiver for optical fibre system).
